senses.gloss: yaśas (CII 1), glory in this life; cf. yaśo vā kīrtir = vā. See kīrti.

yaṣṭi (EI 33; CII 4; ML), a memorial pillar; a relic pillar raised in memory of the dead.
 Cf. jaṣṭi (EI 19), a land measure.
 Cf. laṣṭi (EI 16), a memorial pillar.
 Cf. śilā-yaṣṭi (LL), a stone pillar.
Yāṣṭika (HD), staff bearer; an attendant on the king. See Rājataraṅgiṇī, VI. 203; Pāṇini, IV. 4. 59. See Vetrika, Piśuna-vetrika.
Yaṣṭi-prātiṣṭhānaka (ML), the erection of a pillar; same as Sanskrit yaṣṭi-pratiṣṭhāpana.
